title: Credential Exchange Offer — payload
description: Issuer to holder: an OID4VCI Credential Offer. Opens the issuance thread; the holder replies with credential-exchange/request.

credential_offer.description: An OID4VCI Credential Offer object, carried verbatim. Its members are defined by OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance and are deliberately NOT re-specified here — this task is the transport, authentication and threading envelope, and re-stating a foreign specification's shape would create a second source of truth that drifts. snake_case member names are OID4VCI's own.
